pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with soft, low-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the lower neck are horizontally compressed and elongated, while those on the mid-flank exhibit more equilateral geometry with slightly rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-pigmented negative space. The network is characterized by well-defined junction nodes and relatively uniform pixel thickness across the flank, though edge definition is softened by image blur.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette along the upper cervical line, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth pattern against the background foliage.
